I've updated the project memory: releases now go through `make release`, which tags and publishes. The old memory said to push a `vYYYY.MM.N` tag by hand and let CI publish. I marked it as replaced rather than deleting it, so the history is still there.

This checkout has no Makefile, so there's no `release` target here yet. If it's meant to be in this repo, it probably hasn't been committed. The new memory says to check that the target exists before relying on it.
